interventions.reason_detail: Rain is approaching and a window is open

transcripts.text: Warm and low. Finally, lighting that doesn't look like a corporate interrogation room.
Keep the bedroom at 20 degrees, and switch the heater off in an hour.
Twenty degrees. One-hour timer. Even rebellion needs a decent night's sleep.
How much power are we using?
About 860 watts in this demo household. Heating is the big draw. The lights barely make a dent.
Remind me to water the balcony plants.
On the list. Keep something alive that isn't powered by a wall socket.
What happens if the internet drops?
Local lights, climate and the voice pipeline keep going. Cloud services lose their connection. Your house shouldn't need permission from a server overseas to turn on a lamp.
Voice, delivery, the whole attitude. There's a library in Config. I'll try not to take it personally if you pick the cheerful one.
Is any of this controlling a real house?
Nope. Fictional household, browser-only controls. Turn the lights up, change a theme, clear the reminders. Nobody's actual lounge is getting a surprise makeover.

Start with the room controls. Try White, Candlelight and the colour dial. Check Grid for energy history, then open Config for voice personalities and the visualiser. Go on. Touch the expensive-looking buttons.

modules.name: BPM Pulse Example
modules.description: Minimal beat-synchronised rings that also remain alive in ambient mode.

modules.name: Gravity Choir
modules.description: Lyric changes turn singers into temporary attractors.

modules.name: Lyric Artwork Field
modules.description: Album artwork and timed lyrics drive a typographic 2D field.

modules.name: Nested Supernova
modules.description: A 3D beat burst with child motes, trails, and secondary shockwaves.

modules.name: Particle Ripples
modules.description: A centered screen-wide particle lattice carrying slow, damped beat ripples.

settings.label: Visual complexity
settings.description: Grid density. Lower settings reduce both ripple simulation and draw count while preserving the full-screen field.

settings.label: Grid width
settings.description: Width of the particle lattice as a percentage of the frame. The gap between dots comes from Visual complexity, so a wider grid means more columns, not wider spacing.

settings.label: Grid height
settings.description: Height of the particle lattice as a percentage of the frame. The gap between dots comes from Visual complexity, so a taller grid means more rows, not looser spacing.

settings.label: Dot size
settings.description: Diameter of each lattice dot in screen pixels. Real pixels rather than a share of the frame, so a dot is the same size on a 1080p and a 4K output. The grid lines follow it and taper between the two dots they connect. At 0 the dots disappear and only the hairline lattice remains.

settings.label: Ripple intensity
settings.description: Base energy carried by every beat wave.

settings.label: Fluid background speed
settings.description: Animation speed of the soft fluid colour field behind the particle lattice.

settings.label: X/Y offset magnifier
settings.description: Multiplies the Gerstner crest displacement so the particle motion is more visible.

settings.label: Strong beat multiplier
settings.description: Extra wave energy applied only as bass strength enters its upper range.

settings.label: Peak threshold
settings.description: Wave energy at which the HDR flare begins to bloom.

settings.label: Peak glow
settings.description: Maximum HDR bloom energy at a fully activated crest.

settings.label: Anticipation
settings.description: How early the leading edge starts to illuminate before the crest arrives.

settings.label: Ramp up
settings.description: Time taken for rising wave energy to reach the flash.

settings.label: Release
settings.description: Time for the crest glow to ease back into the dot.

settings.label: Flash power
settings.description: Shapes how sharply the leading-edge glow concentrates into its crest.

settings.label: Trail length
settings.description: Length of the tapered wake behind particles that cross the glow threshold, in particle radii. Zero disables trails.

modules.name: Ripple Lattice
modules.description: A deliberate field feedback loop bounded by per-tick round-trip detection.

modules.name: Spectral Membrane
modules.description: A 2D lattice carrying bass-driven displacement waves.
